enchantment.dross.necromancy.desc: Hits have a chance to raise the undead to fight for you.
enchantment.dross.deathforged.desc: Your risen undead come armored. Higher levels forge stronger gear.
advancements.dross.rise.title: Rise!
advancements.dross.root.title: Dross
advancements.dross.root.description: Something is leaking out of the rift.
advancements.dross.weathered_letter.desc: Find an old letter in the Nether.
advancements.dross.proven_worthy.title: Proven Worthy
advancements.dross.proven_worthy.descrip: Bring the Dross Trader his three tributes.
advancements.dross.keymaster.title: Keymaster
advancements.dross.keymaster.description: Have the Dross Trader forge the Rift Key.
dross.trader.dialogue.intro: You've come about the rift? I don't believe you're strong enough. Show me. Bring me a skull from the Nether's fortresses, shards from the cities of the deep dark, and stone from the End.
dross.trader.dialogue.reminder_tributes: I am still waiting. Bring me: %1$s.
dross.trader.dialogue.reminder_key_mater: A key needs materials. Bring me: %1$s.
dross.trader.dialogue.accepted: Good. I will take that. Still needed: %1$s.
dross.trader.dialogue.not_enough: That is not enough. I need all of it at once: %1$s.
dross.trader.dialogue.already_have: I already have enough %1$s from you.
dross.trader.dialogue.not_yet: Not yet. Prove yourself with the three tributes first.
dross.trader.dialogue.tributes_complete: So you are stronger than you look. Take this compass: it points to the rift. I know how to forge a key to open it, but I need materials. Bring me: %1$s.
dross.trader.dialogue.key_forged: It is done. The key is yours. Use it at the rift, and be careful what you let out.
dross.trader.dialogue.key_replaced: Another key, then. Try not to lose this one.
dross.trader.dialogue.compass_replaced: You lost your compass? Here, take another. It will still point to the rift.
dross.trader.dialogue.lost_key: No key? I can forge you another, but it needs the same materials. Bring me: %1$s.
book.dross.blank: The ink is too faded to read... for now.
book.dross.weathered_letter.page1:
To whoever finds this,

An old villager has made his home beside a village close to where the world began.

He is seeking someone strong enough to face what lies beyond the rift.
book.dross.weathered_letter.page2:
You will find him %1$s of where the world began, near X %2$s, Z %3$s, in an old chapel at the edge of the village.

Tell him you have come about the rift.

- A friend
book.dross.weathered_letter.page2_near_s:
You will find him close to where the world began, near X %1$s, Z %2$s, in an old chapel at the edge of the village.

Tell him you have come about the rift.

- A friend
book.dross.weathered_letter.page2_unknow:
I cannot say exactly where he is. Look in the village nearest to where the world began, at its very edge.

Tell him you have come about the rift.

- A friend
book.dross.dross_guide_book.page1:
THE DROSS

A guide for those who stepped through the rift.

(Placeholder text: the full guide is still being written.)
book.dross.dross_guide_book.page2:
Where you are

The Dross is a flat land of endless night. The sun never rises here.

You arrived at the hub. Its portal leads back to the castle you came from.
book.dross.dross_guide_book.page3:
The hub

No monsters are born near the hub. It is the only safe ground in the Dross.

But they can still walk in from the dark.
book.dross.dross_guide_book.page4:
The dead

Zombies and skeletons here wear netherite. Their gear crumbles when they die.

Some carry forgotten knowledge: books of Deathforged.
book.dross.dross_guide_book.page5:
No way out

No portal can be lit inside the Dross. The hub's portal is the only way home.

Travel carefully.
